Seismic design requires that bars in the plastic hinge region do not slip under repeated loading, so l_a is multiplied by ζaE (1.15 for grades one and two, 1.05 for grade three) to make anchorage more reliable.

map.基本锚固长度 l_ab = α × (f_y ÷ f_t) × d（mm，α=0: Basic anchorage length l_ab = α × (f_y ÷ f_t) × d (mm, α=0.14 is the shape factor for ribbed bars); tension anchorage length l_a = max(ζ_a × l_ab, 200 mm) (GB 50010-2010 8.3.1). ζ_a is graded per 8.3.2: (1) ribbed bar nominal diameter d>25mm → 1.10; (2) epoxy-coated ribbed bar → 1.25; (3) bars susceptible to disturbance during construction → 1.10; (4) concrete cover 3d → 0.80, 5d → 0.70, linear interpolation in between (c<3d → 0.80); these factors may be multiplied, and should not be less than 0.6. Item (4) in the code ("provided area greater than required area") must be applied manually as the design/provided area ratio; this page does not judge it automatically. Meter value = l_a ÷ 1000 (m). Validation: if any of f_y, f_t, d or ζ_a is ≤0, the page reports "Please enter valid parameters.".
